description.short_caption: Histopathology showing foamy macrophages with intracellular organisms.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a tissue section stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The field contains numerous foamy macrophages with pale cytoplasm and scattered intracellular structures. The background stroma appears mildly edematous, and there is a sparse inflammatory infiltrate. The findings are consistent with a tissue infection, potentially involving intracellular bacteria.

description.short_caption: Histopathology showing fungal elements with surrounding necrosis.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows numerous fungal elements, including broad, ribbon-like hyphae with non-parallel walls and occasional branching. The surrounding tissue demonstrates necrosis and inflammatory infiltrates. The fungal morphology is consistent with organisms such as Mucorales. The image is stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E), highlighting the fungal structures and tissue architecture.

description.short_caption: Transoesophageal echocardiogram showing a large pedunculated vegetation on the aortic valve.
description.detailed_description: This image consists of two panels from a transoesophageal echocardiogram. The left panel shows the mid-oesophageal aortic valve long axis view, while the right panel shows the mid-oesophageal aortic valve short axis view. A large, pedunculated echogenic mass consistent with vegetation is visible on the aortic valve in both views. The vegetation appears irregular and mobile, suggesting infective endocarditis.
